about_the_game:
If you have a need for speed the ElectroStreak 1.1m is one of the fastest prop-driven E-flite airplanes ever! With 3S 1800–2200mAh batteries and the factory-installed brushless power system, the ElectroStreak reaches up to 100 MPH — making it a great choice for intermediate pilots with some high-speed flying experience, especially when utilizing AS3X+ and SAFE Select with automatic Hand Launch Assist Mode technologies. And more experienced pilots can unleash top speeds of up to 120-130 MPH with popular 4S 1800–2200mAh batteries!

 

Speed and aerobatic enthusiasts will appreciate the locked-in precision of the four digital, metal-geared servos and ball-link equipped linkages. They make it possible to perform a wide range of sport to high-speed aerobatics, and the optional-use flaperons and spoilerons offer even more capabilities! The sleek airframe is composite reinforced throughout and is molded in high-density EPO that delivers a strong and stiff airframe. Plus, it's factory-finished in a vibrant, high-contrast trim scheme for improved visibility and orientation. No glue is required for assembly, and a total of three screws install the stabilizer plus the one-piece wing that attaches and removes easily for convenient storage and transport. That means you can be ready to enjoy a fast-flying experience unlike any other in less time than it takes to charge a battery!

 

This model is equipped with Horizon Hobby and Spektrum exclusive AS3X (Artificial Stabilization – 3-aXis) and optional-use SAFE (Sensor Assisted Flight Envelope) Select technologies, and when SAFE Select is turned on using the mode switch (B on the Spektrum InterLink DX controller) it offers: 

 

Pitch and Bank Angle Limits 

These envelope limits keep the airplane from rolling or pitching upside down.  They also prevent excessive climb or dive angles.

 

Automatic Self-Leveling 

The airplane instantly returns to and holds level flight when the sticks are released and in the center position.  It’s also helpful for keeping the wings level during takeoffs and landings.
